propositions: Two capability decisions currently use provider-name string matching and silently fail for Bedrock-hosted Claude, whose model profile diverges from direct Anthropic API
output_mode() and prompt-cache settings must be routed via ModelProfile.supports_json_schema_output and profile type/fields, not hardcoded provider name strings
capabilities_for() must accept both model objects with a .profile attribute and lazy provider-qualified model strings, resolving profiles without constructing providers

Bedrock-hosted Claude must be identified by profile field presence (bedrock_supports_prompt_caching, bedrock_thinking_variant='anthropic') rather than isinstance() against BedrockModelProfile, to avoid forcing boto3 import in CI
A rebar override table must force Anthropic to native_structured_output=False despite profile flag, to preserve the existing PromptedOutput contract
Groq changes from NativeOutput to PromptedOutput as its profile reports supports_json_schema_output=False, which is the disclosed safe behavior change
